parentPin.title: PIN code
parentPin.hasPinDescription: Your personal PIN protects parent mode — children cannot leave child mode without your PIN.
parentPin.noPinDescription: Set your own 4-digit PIN — children cannot leave child mode without your PIN.
parentPin.forgotIntro: Enter your password to set a new PIN.
parentPin.pinsMismatch: PINs do not match — try again
parentPin.sessionExpired: Session expired — enter current PIN again

push.title: Push notifications
push.lead: Get notifications on your phone — even when the app is closed.
push.unsupported: Your browser does not support push notifications.
push.toggleDescription: Turn on to receive notifications about your children's activities
push.typeInactivityHint: 18:00 if the child has not logged in
push.archiveHint: Successful push notifications from the last 7 days
push.permissionDenied: 🚫 Permission denied. Enable in your browser or app settings.
push.iosNotInstalled: Add {{brand}} to your Home Screen for push in Safari.

errors.unsupportedBrowser: Push is not supported in this browser
errors.permissionDeniedApp: Notification permission was denied in app settings.
errors.pushPluginMissing: Push plugin is missing in the app. Run npx cap sync ios and rebuild.
errors.permissionDeniedBrowser: Notification permission denied. Enable it in your browser settings.
errors.iosNotInstalled: Add the app to your Home Screen for push in Safari.

prompt.title: Add a widget to your Home Screen?
prompt.lead: See the next activity on your Home Screen — without opening the app.
prompt.step1: Tap Connect widget here in the app.
prompt.step2: On the Home Screen: long-press the background → tap + → search for {{brand}}.

settings.title: Widgets and quick access
settings.description: Personal widget = one child. Family widget = multiple children. Choose a child here if you have more than one.
settings.childPickerLabel: Which child should the widget show?
settings.supportMissing: Widget support is missing in this version. Update the app.
settings.addChildFirst: Add a child to the family first, then you can connect the widget.
settings.loginRequired: You must be logged in to connect the widget.
settings.success: Done! Add the widget to your Home Screen (+ → {{brand}}) if you have not already.
settings.pickChild: Choose a child in the list above and try again.
settings.retryLater: Could not connect right now. Try again in a moment.
settings.networkError: Could not connect right now. Check your network and try again.

errors.offlineUnavailable: The widget is not enabled for your family yet. Contact support if it should be on.
errors.reauthRequired: Your session needs to be renewed. Log out and back in, then try reconnecting.
errors.nativeConfigureFailed: The app could not save the widget link. Close the app completely and open it again.
errors.notEnabled: The widget is not enabled or your session needs to be renewed. Log out and back in.
